data: Cycle shows the main bottleneck is zero-gradient groups: 105/240 all-fail. At r=50 there are still 80 all-fail groups, including many straightforward problems whose rollouts collapse to placeholders like 'x' or a default wrong answer; these need a stronger per-problem hint dose to produce at least one success. The r=0 bucket also has 25 all-fail groups and should be moved into a nonzero hint regime rather than remaining gradientless. Text notes appear helpful overall: with-text prompts have a much lower all-fail rate than bare prompts, so increase p and replace the current vague note with concrete anti-placeholder/check-and-compute guidance plus a general solution skeleton for short algebra/word/choice problems. All-pass r=50 groups can be annealed down since they are already solved at that dose.
